caption: A base over 30 notes with 150 tasks: one row per task with dates, priority, tags, note and heading.
eval: (async () => { const kept = app.workspace.getMostRecentLeaf(); for (const leaf of [...app.workspace.getLeavesOfType('markdown'), ...app.workspace.getLeavesOfType('bases')]) if (leaf !== kept) leaf.detach(); app.workspace.setActiveLeaf(kept, { focus: true });  await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 800)); return 'ok'; })()

caption: The filter box with the word budget leaves only the matching tasks.
eval: (async () => { await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 600)); const v = [...app.plugins.plugins['bases-task-rows'].views].find((x) => x.rootEl.isConnected && document.querySelector('.workspace-leaf.mod-active')?.contains(x.rootEl)); const s = v.rootEl.querySelector('.btr-search'); s.value = 'budget'; s.dispatchEvent(new Event('input')); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); return 'ok'; })()

caption: Pro: open tasks grouped under Overdue, Today, Next 7 days, Later and No date.
eval: (async () => { const p = app.plugins.plugins['bases-task-rows']; p.pro.opts.http = async () => ({ status: 200, json: { data: { viewer: { login: 'demo-reader' }, user: { sponsorshipForViewerAsSponsor: { isActive: true, isOneTimePayment: false, tier: { name: '$5 a month', monthlyPriceInCents: 500 } } } } } }); app.secretStorage.setSecret('bases-task-rows-github-token', 'gho_' + '0'.repeat(36)); await p.pro.refreshNow(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 800)); return 'ok'; })()

caption: Pro: three selected rows with Complete selected and Move selected to today, and a date picker open in a due cell.
eval: (async () => { const p = app.plugins.plugins['bases-task-rows']; p.pro.opts.http = async () => ({ status: 200, json: { data: { viewer: { login: 'demo-reader' }, user: { sponsorshipForViewerAsSponsor: { isActive: true, isOneTimePayment: false, tier: { name: '$5 a month', monthlyPriceInCents: 500 } } } } } }); app.secretStorage.setSecret('bases-task-rows-github-token', 'gho_' + '0'.repeat(36)); await p.pro.refreshNow(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 800)); const v = [...app.plugins.plugins['bases-task-rows'].views].find((x) => x.rootEl.isConnected && document.querySelector('.workspace-leaf.mod-active')?.contains(x.rootEl)); const ids = v.shownIds(); for (const id of ids.slice(1, 4)) { [...v.rootEl.querySelectorAll('tr.btr-row')].find((tr) => tr.dataset.id === id).querySelector('td.btr-col-select input').click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100)); } [...v.rootEl.querySelectorAll('tr.btr-row')].find((tr) => tr.dataset.id === ids[5]).querySelector('td.btr-col-due').click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); return 'ok'; })()
after: (async () => { const v = [...app.plugins.plugins['bases-task-rows'].views].find((x) => x.rootEl.isConnected && document.querySelector('.workspace-leaf.mod-active')?.contains(x.rootEl)); v.selected.clear(); v.render(); app.plugins.plugins['bases-task-rows'].pro.signOut(); return 'ok'; })()
